resources.string: Receivers such as WinPlay check the phone\'s real Bluetooth address, which Android does not let ordinary apps read. With Shizuku running it is read and saved automatically; without Shizuku, find Bluetooth address in the phone settings and enter it here (usually under Settings → My device → All specs, or Status).
\nThe manually entered %1$s differs from the live read; the live read is used when connecting.
The format is wrong, or this is not the phone\'s public Bluetooth address (02:00:00:00:00:00, for example, is the system placeholder)
